homeDesignPage.title: Home design
homeDesignPage.subtitle: Design the Home start page: the product tile grid, the colour theme, and the welcome content. Changes apply to every customer's Home.
homeDesignPage.tileBackgroundHint: Optional. Shown behind the tile colour; the icon and title get a shadow so they stay readable.
homeDesignPage.tileLinkHint: Pick a page or product to turn the tile into a clickable shortcut — just like the product tiles.
homeDesignPage.placementHint_grid: The tile sits in the grid and flows into place with the others.
homeDesignPage.placementHint_fixed: The tile leaves the grid and pins to the edge of the content area — it stays on screen even when the page scrolls.
homeDesignPage.placementHint_sticky: The tile leaves the grid and sits at the edge — it follows the page, but sticks to the edge while it is in view.
homeDesignPage.placementSlotHint: Only one tile fits in each of the nine positions; positions already taken cannot be picked.

homeDesignPage.tilesHint: Drag to reposition; the other tiles flow around them. Use the icon on a tile to switch it between 1×1 and 2×2.

homeDesignPage.heroHint: JPG about 1600×600 px. Cropped to fill, so keep the key content centred.

handheldActions.deployHint: Builds the latest code as a signed APK and publishes it at the fixed download address. The QR code never changes — customers automatically get the new version. Requires the deploy worker running on the build machine.

handheldDesignPage.title: Handheld design

handheldDesignPage.heroHint: JPG about 1600×600 px. Cropped to fill, so keep the key content centred.
handheldDesignPage.themeHint: The device's color scheme (background, panels and text) shown in the preview. Midnight is the handheld's original look.
handheldDesignPage.iconThemeHint: Happy is the handheld's original look (emoji). Desktop uses exactly the same icons as the web app. Outline, Solid and Mono use Android's own Material icons. Emoji carry their own colors, so a tile's color has no effect in Happy.
handheldDesignPage.tilesHint: Drag to move a tile; the others flow into place. Use the gear to change its appearance and the cross to remove it from the home screen. Tiles only appear for customers entitled to each feature.

handheldDesignPage.colorEmojiHint: Emoji carry their own colors — the color applies once you pick another icon theme.
handheldDesignPage.folderHint: Tiles on the sub-page — configure, reorder or add/remove. Shown on the handheld sub-page in the same order.

operiaMapsPage.title: Maps & routes

operiaMapsPage.googleDesc: Best data and live-traffic ETAs, but requires an API key and a billing account.
operiaMapsPage.keySecretHint: Stored only as a Supabase edge secret and used server-side — never in the database or browser. Set or replace it with:
operiaMapsPage.browserKeyHint: A DIFFERENT key from the server key above. The Maps JavaScript API runs in the user's browser, so this key is public by design — protect it in Google Cloud with an HTTP referrer restriction to your domain and limit it to the Maps JavaScript API only. Without it, routes cannot be shown on a map while Google is selected.
operiaMapsPage.browserKeyReloadHint: If you change the key, open tabs must be reloaded before the new one takes effect.

assetDataConfig.previewHint: This is how the next numbers will look.

Once every parcel is resolved, the employee is anonymized. Anonymization cannot be undone: name, email, phone and employee number are permanently removed, while the parcel history is kept.
